segments.name: K2
segments.prompt: A chibi blonde star sorceress floating in the air, long golden hair, amber eyes, a white and purple witch hat crowned with golden stars and a crescent moon, small golden wings, a white, gold and purple star gown with a long cape, white armoured boots, holding a tall golden spear-staff topped with a star inside golden orbit rings in her right hand, already recoiling from a hard hit at the first frame, dazed with eyes shut, immediately begins recovering: no second jolt. She opens her eyes, steadies herself with a slight knee flex and returns smoothly to her guard stance of the last frame; hair and cape swing with one diminishing overshoot. She keeps floating in the air on the same spot, feet off the ground, without drifting; no turning or scale change. Arms, shoulders and torso drive the action; hair, cloth and cape follow with natural overlapping motion. Preserve her identity, costume, proportions and the single rigid staff, always drawn whole and clearly visible. No added effects, aura, glow, dust or particles.

game.plan: rest -> recoil (giật tức thì) -> K2 hồi phục -> rest
